dedupe_keys.name: toronto zoning by law 569 2013 spatial files

description: City of Toronto publishes the spatial files of Zoning By-law 569-2013 (zoning areas and overlays for policy area, road, rooming house, height and lot coverage, among 92 resources), updated for amendments up to 18 June 2023, plus static shapefiles for sections approved by Council but still under appeal. Coverage: the City of Toronto; the portal record was last modified on 2026-02-20. Format and access: GeoJSON, Shapefile, CSV, downloadable without registration from the City of Toronto Open Data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Government Licence - Toronto, as shown on the dataset page (the CKAN API licence field reads "License not specified"); cost: free. Caveats: the page says the spatial files must be read with the by-law text and are not a legal reference; the amendments date is mid-2023 while the record shows a later portal update; the CKAN API licence field is empty although the page shows the Open Government Licence - Toronto; the files were not opened. Simulation uses: land-use and building-envelope constraints for urban growth, exposure and energy-demand scenarios, and as a planning-regulatory layer to join with parcels and address points. Related catalogue records: Urban Form Toronto: built environment and walkability measures on a 100 m hexagon grid (data-toronto-urban-form-hex-measures); City of Toronto watermain breaks 1990 to 2016 (data-toronto-watermain-breaks); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
